The user wants a summary of the causes of the French Revolution in five paragraphs, followed by a list of ten key dates. Let me organize this carefully.

Causes of the French Revolution - I need to cover the main causes across five paragraphs:
1. Social/structural causes - the Three Estates system, inequality
2. Economic causes - debt, tax system, bad harvests, fiscal crisis
3. Political causes - absolute monarchy, lack of representation, weak leadership of Louis XVI
4. Intellectual causes - Enlightenment ideas, influence of philosophers, American Revolution
5. Immediate triggers - Estates-General, bread prices, financial crisis

Then ten key dates:
1. 1789 May 5 - Estates-General opens at Versailles
2. 1789 June 17 - Tennis Court Oath
3. 1789 July 14 - Storming of the Bastille
4. 1789 August 4 - Abolition of feudalism
5. 1789 August 26 - Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen
6. 1792 September 20 - Battle of Valmy / Proclamation of Republic
7. 1792 October 6 - Storming of the Tuileries, abolition of monarchy
8. 1793 January 21 - Execution of Louis XVI
9. 1793-1794 - Reign of Terror
10. 1799 November 9 - Coup of 18 Brumaire (end of the Revolution)
